verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing site says directly: "Email or upload receipts and we'll auto-attach them to the right card transaction." Programmatic support backs this up: an "Upload a transaction attachment" API endpoint, receipt uploads listed as an API write action, and an official mercury-receipt-upload agent skill. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the email forwarding and auto-matching work (setup, matching logic, handling of mismatches), and any independent or hands-on confirmation that auto-attachment works reliably.
